basics.description: Deploys Arc Jumpstart ArcBox. Pick the flavor here; the client VM size, networking and source settings are on the following tabs.

basics.name: sqlServerEdition
basics.label: SQL Server edition
basics.toolTip: Edition of SQL Server on the nested SQL VM.

basics.name: namingPrefix
basics.label: Naming prefix
basics.toolTip: Prefix for all resources and nested VMs (max 7 characters).

constraints.validationMessage: 1-7 letters or numbers, starting with a letter.

basics.name: windowsAdminUsername
basics.label: Windows admin username
basics.toolTip: Admin account for the client VM.

basics.name: windowsAdminPassword
basics.toolTip: 12-123 characters with upper case, lower case, a number and a special character.

constraints.validationMessage: 12-123 characters with upper case, lower case, a number and a special character.

basics.name: sshRSAPublicKey
basics.label: SSH RSA public key
basics.toolTip: Required for the DevOps and DataOps flavors (K3s/AKS Linux nodes).

elements.name: nestedVmDiskLayout
elements.label: Nested VM disks
elements.toolTip: One shared disk: all nested VM VHDX files on one data disk. One disk per nested VM: an extra Premium SSD v2 data disk for each nested VM, so they do not compete for IOPS. Total disk performance is still capped by the client VM size.

elements.name: clientVmSizeShared
elements.label: Client VM size
elements.toolTip: Size of the ArcBox client VM that hosts the nested VMs. Limited to v5 or newer D/E-series x64 sizes with 8+ vCPUs and 32+ GB of memory.

elements.name: clientVmSizePerVm
elements.label: Client VM size
elements.toolTip: Size of the ArcBox client VM. With one disk per nested VM, only sizes whose disk IOPS and throughput limits can drive the default per-VM disks are shown.

elements.name: nestedVmDiskSizeGB
elements.label: Per-VM disk size
elements.toolTip: Size of each per-VM data disk (largest VHDX, SQL, is about 58 GB). Capped below the 256 GB shared VMs disk.

elements.name: nestedVmDiskIOPS
elements.label: Per-VM disk IOPS
elements.toolTip: Premium SSD v2 includes 3000 IOPS per disk at no extra charge. Max 500 IOPS per GB of disk size.

elements.name: nestedVmDiskMBps
elements.label: Per-VM disk throughput
elements.toolTip: Premium SSD v2 includes 125 MB/s per disk at no extra charge. Max 0.25 MB/s per IOPS.

elements.name: diskPerformanceCheck
elements.label: Disk performance check
elements.defaultValue: Checked against the selected VM size
elements.toolTip: Adds up the provisioned IOPS and throughput of every disk on the client VM: OS disk (500 IOPS / 100 MB/s), shared VMs disk (3000 IOPS / 125 MB/s) and one per-VM disk per nested VM (5 for ITPro, 1 for DataOps), and compares them with the VM size limits.

validations.message: Per-VM disks must be smaller than the 256 GB shared VMs disk.
Per-VM disk IOPS is above the Premium SSD v2 limit of 500 IOPS per GB. Lower the IOPS or increase the disk size.
Per-VM disk throughput is above the Premium SSD v2 limit of 0.25 MB/s per IOPS. Lower the throughput or raise the IOPS.

elements.name: enableAzureSpotPricing
elements.label: Use Azure Spot pricing for the client VM

elements.name: vmAutologon
elements.label: Enable autologon (runs the setup scripts automatically after reboot)

elements.name: autoShutdownTimezone
elements.label: Auto-shutdown time zone
elements.toolTip: Windows time zone ID, for example "UTC" or "Pacific Standard Time".

elements.name: deployNatGateway
elements.label: Deploy a NAT Gateway for outbound internet access
elements.toolTip: Required where policy blocks default outbound access. Always deployed with Bastion or the DevOps/DataOps flavors.

elements.name: deployBastion
elements.label: Deploy Azure Bastion (client VM gets no public IP)

elements.name: vhdStorageAccountName
elements.label: VHD storage account (empty = public Jumpstart storage)

constraints.validationMessage: 3-24 letters, numbers or hyphens, starting with a letter.

elements.name: debugEnabled
elements.label: Debug mode for the automation scripts
